blocks.prompt: 10 Draw the graph of \(f(x) = |x|\) after applying in order, shift of 7 units to right, horizontal compress by factor 2, vertical shift 6 units downward, and vertical compress by factor 2.
blocks.explanation:
Graph banana hai, magar pehle chaar transformations se naya function nikalna hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = |x|\), yani V-shape graph jis ka kona origin par hai.
Find kya karna hai? Chaaron tabdeeliyon ke baad graph.
Rule: 7 daayen = \(x \to x - 7\); 2 se horizontal compression = \(x \to 2x\); 6 neeche = 6 minus; 2 se vertical compression = poore ko \(\frac{1}{2}\) se zarb.
Plan: function nikal kar us ka kona aur intercepts dhoondein, phir V banayein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = |x|\).
Banana: chaar transformations tarteeb se lagane ke baad graph.
Tareeqa: \(y = f(x - 7)\); \(y = g(2x)\); \(y = h(x) - 6\); \(y = \frac{1}{2}k(x)\). Har qadam sab se naye function par.

Qadam 1: 7 units daayen
\[g_{1}(x) = |x - 7|\]
Kyun: har \(x\) ki jagah \(x - 7\); V ka kona \((7, 0)\) par chala gaya.

Qadam 2: 2 se horizontal compression
\[g_{2}(x) = |2x - 7|\]
Kyun: \(g_{1}\) ke har \(x\) ki jagah \(2x\). Dhyan dein: \(|2(x - 7)| = |2x - 14|\) ghalat hai; sirf \(x\) badalta hai.

Qadam 3: 6 units neeche
\[g_{3}(x) = |2x - 7| - 6\]
Kyun: har output mein se 6 kam kiya.

Qadam 4: 2 se vertical compression
\[g(x) = \tfrac{1}{2}\left(|2x - 7| - 6\right)\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}|2x - 7| - 3\]
Kyun: poora mojooda function aadha hota hai, is liye \(-6\) bhi aadha ho kar \(-3\) ban gaya.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{1}{2}|2x - 7| - 6\) likhna sab se aam ghalti hai; shift pehle hui thi, is liye woh bhi compress hogi.

Kona aur intercepts
\[\text{kona}: 2x - 7 = 0 \Rightarrow \left(\tfrac{7}{2}, -3\right)\]
\[g(0) = \tfrac{7}{2} - 3 = \tfrac{1}{2}\]
\[|2x - 7| = 6 \Rightarrow x = \tfrac{1}{2},\ \tfrac{13}{2}\]
Kyun: V wahan murta hai jahan modulus ke andar zero ho. \(x\)-intercepts ke liye \(g(x) = 0\): \(\frac{1}{2}|2x - 7| = 3\), yani \(|2x - 7| = 6\), yani \(2x - 7 = 6\) ya \(-6\).

Graph banaiye
\((3.5, -3)\), \((0, 0.5)\), \((0.5, 0)\), \((6.5, 0)\) plot karein aur kone se do seedhi baazu kheenchein, ek ka slope \(-1\) aur doosre ka \(+1\).
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{2}|2x - 7| = \left|x - \frac{7}{2}\right|\), is liye \(g(x) = \left|x - \frac{7}{2}\right| - 3\). Yani asal mein yeh wahi \(|x|\) wala V hai, sirf 3.5 daayen aur 3 neeche sarka hua. Is khaas misaal mein horizontal compression ne baazuon ka slope \(\pm 2\) kar diya tha aur vertical compression ne wapas \(\pm 1\) kar diya, is liye V ki chaurai wahi rahi.

Tasdeeq:
\(|x|\) ka kona \((0, 0)\) follow karein: 7 daayen \(\to (7, 0)\); compression \(\to (3.5, 0)\); 6 neeche \(\to (3.5, -6)\); vertical compression \(\to (3.5, -3)\). Wahi kona jo upar mila.
blocks.final_answer: \(g(x) = \frac{1}{2}|2x - 7| - 3\): V-shape graph jis ka kona \((3.5, -3)\) hai; yeh \(x\)-axis ko \((0.5, 0)\) aur \((6.5, 0)\) par aur \(y\)-axis ko \((0, 0.5)\) par kaatta hai.
